stories.title: Acreano que vive há 10 anos com doença renal aguarda transplante do irmão: ‘Anos de luta’

en.title: Man from Acre living with kidney disease for 10 years awaits transplant from brother: 'Years of struggle'
en.summary: A cinematographer from Brazil's Acre state who has suffered from chronic kidney disease for over a decade is awaiting a potential kidney transplant from his brother after years on a waiting list.

stories.title: ‘Parece que a ficha ainda não caiu’, diz mãe que retornou ao Brasil após 4 anos longe dos filhos

en.title: 'It feels like it hasn't sunk in yet', says mother who returned to Brazil after 4 years away from her children
en.summary: A mother returns to Brazil temporarily after nearly four years working in Spain and reunites with her two children in Palmas in an emotional, pre-arranged meeting.

stories.title: Costelinha com guariroba: Jornal do Campo ensina receita goiana saborosa

en.title: Pork ribs with guariroba: Jornal do Campo teaches delicious Goiás recipe
en.summary: A culinary program presents a pork ribs with guariroba recipe prepared by a chef known for regional Brazilian cooking who combines traditional ingredients with international cooking techniques.

stories.title: 'Agudo grave' de Zélia Duncan se abre na pulsação transformadora de show com direção musical de Maria Beraldo

en.title: 'Agudo grave' by Zélia Duncan opens with transformative pulse of show under musical direction by Maria Beraldo
en.summary: Singer Zélia Duncan releases her 15th studio album titled 'Agudo grave' with musical direction by Maria Beraldo, reinterpreting previous hits with fresh sonic arrangements.

stories.title: US Offers Argentina Up to US$7 Billion for a Gas and Minerals Corridor

en.title: US Offers Argentina Up to US$7 Billion for a Gas and Minerals Corridor
en.summary: The United States is backing the Andes-Atlantic Corridor to provide Argentina with up to $7 billion in export credit through 2027 for developing its remote oil, gas and mineral resources. Most of the funding is designated as a non-binding credit line for a single liquefied natural gas project.

stories.title: Argentina’s Next Six F-16 Fighters Held in the Canaries by Weather

en.title: Argentina's Next Six F-16 Fighters Held in the Canaries by Weather
en.summary: Six F-16 fighter jets purchased from Denmark are currently delayed in the Canary Islands due to weather conditions, with expected arrival by September 30. This is the second batch of 24 aircraft Argentina acquired in 2024 to restore its supersonic fighter jet capability.

stories.title: São Paulo pode registrar 30°C neste domingo (27); confira previsão

en.title: São Paulo may register 30°C this Sunday (27); check forecast
en.summary: São Paulo's capital is expected to experience another hot day on Sunday with temperatures reaching a high of 30°C and a low of 17°C, with sun appearing between clouds.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: são 2 votos para o Senado? Conheça os 16 candidatos do RJ e suas propostas

en.title: 2026 Elections: are there 2 votes for the Senate? Meet the 16 candidates from RJ and their proposals
en.summary: In Brazil's October 4 elections, voters will cast two votes for Senate positions in Rio de Janeiro, where 16 candidates compete for two available seats with eight-year terms.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: saiba em quantos candidatos votar e a ordem de votação

en.title: 2026 Elections: learn how many candidates to vote for and voting order
en.summary: Voters in the 2026 elections can choose up to six candidates, with different digit sequences required for each position: 4 for federal deputy, 5 for state deputy, 3 for senator, and 2 for governor and president.

stories.title: Veja a previsão do tempo para Ivaiporã neste domingo (27)

en.title: See the weather forecast for Ivaiporã this Sunday (27)
en.summary: Ivaiporã is expected to experience a Sunday with sun and many clouds, reaching a high of 31°C, with increasing cloud cover during the afternoon and night.

stories.title: Brasil se opõe às quatro propostas dos EUA no G20 de Comércio

en.title: Brazil opposes four US proposals at G20 Trade meeting
en.summary: Brazil has expressed opposition to four proposals presented by the United States at the G20 Trade meeting.

stories.title: Paridade de gênero ainda levará 120 anos, diz Fórum Econômico Mundial

en.title: Gender parity will take another 120 years, says World Economic Forum
en.summary: The World Economic Forum's 2026 Global Report on Gender Inequalities estimates that achieving gender parity worldwide will take 120 years at the current pace of progress, based on two decades of data from its Global Gender Gap Index.

stories.title: Candidatos à presidência reforçam principais plataformas em horário eleitoral

en.title: Presidential candidates reinforce main platforms during electoral broadcast time
en.summary: In the final stretch before the election, presidential candidates highlighted their key proposals during Saturday's electoral broadcast, with differing focuses on security, economic, and social policies.

stories.title: 37% avaliam o Congresso Nacional como ruim ou péssimo e 18% como ótimo ou bom, diz Datafolha

en.title: 37% rate National Congress as poor or very poor and 18% as excellent or good, says Datafolha
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows that weeks before elections, 37% of voters rate the National Congress negatively while 18% rate it positively, with 40% considering it regular.

stories.title: Irã insiste em solução diplomática após Trump rejeitar plano de paz

en.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
en.summary: Iran stated that diplomacy is the only way to resolve its conflict with the United States and Israel, following Donald Trump's rejection of an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end hostilities.
